instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Clean the noise out of a recording on my own computer with what it can afford, and tell me where the speech is", and give it file (the recording: a file on this computer).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:enhance-speech and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Cleans a recording on this computer (`file`; it is never changed): picks the most expensive noise-removal tier within the CPU budget whose ffmpeg filters (and model file, in the models folder the person granted) exist here (light, near-voice, neural), makes the cleaned sound as the run's declared output (named in `files`), and answers the speech places found by a silence-detect pass, in seconds of the original.
4. It reads and keeps no records: the cleaned sound is the run's declared output.
